rows.grounds: fused sandhi kula+aṣṭamyām+ardha+rātre; locative of midnight on kula-aṣṭamī
fused sandhi citā+madhye; locative in the middle of the pyre
participle/adjective describing the practitioner's settled state

items.question: When and where must the practitioner remain composed during the cremation-ground rite?
premises: The rite occurs at midnight on kula-aṣṭamī.
The practitioner sits in the middle of the pyre.
items.inference: The practitioner must be composed at midnight on kula-aṣṭamī in the pyre's middle.
uncertainties: Exact sense of kula-aṣṭamī is not specified in this chunk.
items.plain_english: At midnight on kula-aṣṭamī, in the middle of the pyre, he is composed.
